subject: Banking
title: SoFi: The All-in-One Fintech
description: A micro-lesson that makes SoFi: The All-in-One Fintech usable.

hook.text: SoFi started refinancing student loans. Now it offers banking, investing, lending, and insurance.

buildup.text: SoFi obtained a national bank charter in 2022. Unlike most fintechs, it can hold deposits without a banking partner.

discovery.text: With a bank charter, SoFi accesses cheap deposit funding.

twist.text: SoFi bought a stadium naming rights deal: SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.

climax.text: SoFi's path shows that fintechs must eventually become banks to compete.

punchline.text: Started as fintech. Got a bank charter. The disruption came full circle.

quiz.question: Why did SoFi obtain a national bank charter?
options: To access cheap deposit funding and offer higher savings rates

details.summary: SoFi evolved from a student loan refinancer into a full-service digital bank offering lending, investing, insurance, and banking products, becoming one of the first fintechs to obtain a national bank charter in the United States.
details.whyItMatters: SoFi's journey from single-product fintech to chartered bank shows the path digital companies must take to compete seriously with traditional banks. Its charter allows it to hold deposits and lend directly.
takeaways: SoFi obtained a national bank charter in 2022 through acquiring Golden Pacific Bancorp
The charter allows SoFi to hold deposits directly, reducing funding costs
SoFi offers student loan refinancing, mortgages, investing, and banking

faq.question: Why was getting a bank charter important for SoFi?
faq.answer: A bank charter allows SoFi to take deposits directly instead of relying on partner banks. This dramatically reduces its cost of funds for lending and gives it regulatory advantages that non-bank fintechs cannot access.

faq.question: How does SoFi compete with traditional banks?
faq.answer: SoFi offers higher savings rates, no account fees, and a single app for all financial products. Its lower overhead without physical branches allows it to pass savings to customers through better rates and fewer fees.
